introText: While it installs, meet the tools that will come with you.
outroText: Tyron, Tyson and Boro share the same tools. Soplos Welcome is waiting for you at the first start.

welcome.desc: One place to update the system, install drivers and kernels, harden security and tune it for gaming.

store.desc: Find, install, update and remove apps from APT, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage, and apply firmware updates with fwupd.

theme-manager.desc: The Xfce theme manager: apply, create, export and import desktop themes, browse wallpapers and set up the panel.

look-manager.desc: Themes and desktop layout for Tyson: what Theme Manager and Layout Switcher do on Xfce and GNOME, now on Plasma.

layout-switcher.desc: Soplos, Dock, Tiling and GNOME. It installs the missing extensions and applies the settings of each layout.

gaming-panel.desc: An overlay panel that opens with Ctrl+Shift+G and controls GameMode live while you play.

appimage-manager.desc: It moves them to ~/AppImages, extracts their icon, creates the menu entry and checks for updates on GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg.

webapp-manager.desc: Turns a site into its own app: its own window, its own icon in the panel and an isolated browser profile.

kernel-installer.desc: A graphical assistant that takes the Linux kernel from source code to your boot.

grub-editor.tag: The boot loader, without touching a file.
grub-editor.desc: Choose the default entry and the timeout, edit the kernel parameters and change the look of the menu.

plymouth-manager.tag: The boot screen, as you like it.
plymouth-manager.desc: A theme gallery with a real preview, installation from a file and removal of the ones you no longer want.

repo-selector.desc: Turn repositories on or off, move .list files to DEB822, find the fastest mirror with a real test and manage the GPG keys.

system-service.desc: Start, stop and enable services and timers, read the logs and find out what slows the boot down. Every change can be undone.

sys-cleaner.tag: Get space back, only what you confirm.
sys-cleaner.desc: It looks for caches, logs, temporary files, Flatpak and Snap leftovers and old kernels, and explains each one before deleting.

soplos.desc: The stable base of Debian with its own kernels, Timeshift snapshots on btrfs and three desktops that share the same tools.

cards.tyron: Light and fast. Runs well with little memory.
cards.tyson: Powerful and customizable down to the last detail.
cards.boro: Clean and modern, with four layouts to choose from.

tyron.desc: Xfce uses very little memory and starts in seconds: it gives modest computers a new life and flies on modern ones.
The panel, menu and desktop you know, and all of it configurable: with Theme Manager you change the whole theme, the wallpapers and the panel in a moment.

tyson.desc: KDE Plasma brings polished effects, widgets on the desktop and the panel and options for everything, with Wayland out of the box.
Panels, themes, icons and layout: Look Manager gathers in one place everything that makes Plasma a desktop made to measure.

boro.desc: GNOME keeps the focus on what you do: an activities overview to find everything, dynamic workspaces and touchpad gestures.
With Layout Switcher you choose between Soplos, Dock, Tiling and plain GNOME: from the traditional desktop to tiling, in one click.
